metadata.question: Did the volcanic plume from Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki on the Indonesian island of Flores drift westward at about 2 pm local time on July 7, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Volcanic plume drifting implies a visible or aerosol plume; the most suitable collection is Sentinel-2 MSI (10 m, multispec, frequent, has B02/04 plus cirrus). - Target: 2 pm local time (Indonesia: UTC+8) on 7 Jul 2025 → look for 2025-07-07 — 2025-07-08 (account for satellite overpass times ≈ 10:30 local) - Location: Mount Lewotobi Laki-Laki on Flores (geom = point where most recent eruption reported). 2. Masking strategy: - Question is about “plume” visibility → I should NOT mask clouds this time, because the plume might look like clouds; instead use QA60 to report percentage cloud coverage, but keep the image. 3. Logic: - If no images taken on 7/8 July (“empty”) or no 10 m pixel over the island (C2 = no valid pixels) → C1 or C2. - Calculate plume location relative to the vent: - at summit (circle 1 km) average ND degree value from trueColor, and - a western sector buffer (~5 km west) to look for plume/particulate signal (ND/cloud intensity) higher than baseline south. - If westward buffer B02 or aerosol index term is above south buffer or summit→ evidence of westward drift; else no drift → A/B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time loc = ee.Geometry.Point([122.781, -8.355]) # Lewotobi Laki-Laki date = '2025-07-07' win = ee.Date(date).advance(1,'day') ext = ee.Date(date).advance(-1,'day') # ±1 day # 2. Data Acquisition S2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(loc) .filterDate(ext, win)) n = S2.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("C1 Empty Collection") print("C1") else: img = S2.first() cloud = img.select('cloud').reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), loc, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('cloud').getInfo() valid = img.select('B2').reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), loc, 60, maxPixels=1e9).get('B2').getInfo() if valid == 0: print("C2 No Valid Pixels") print("C2") # 4. Calculation – test west drift summit = loc.buffer(1000) # near-vent west = loc.buffer(5000).difference(loc.buffer(2000)) # west sector south = loc.buffer(8000).difference(loc.buffer(6000)) # southern control B2mean = lambda g: img.select('B2').reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), g, 60, maxPixels=1e9).get('B2').getInfo() westV = B2mean(west) soutV = B2mean(south) print(f"Images: {n} Cloud%: {cloud:.0f} WestB2: {westV:.0f} SouthB2: {soutV:.0f} PixelsOK: {int(valid)}") if westV is None: # None/NaN print("C3") elif westV > soutV + 2 and westV >= 1: # plume brighter west than south -- simple heuristic print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
loc = ee.Geometry.Point([122.781, -8.355])  # Lewotobi Laki-Laki
date = '2025-07-07'
win = ee.Date(date).advance(1,'day')
ext = ee.Date(date).advance(-1,'day')  # ±1 day

# 2. Data Acquisition
S2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
      .filterBounds(loc)
      .filterDate(ext, win))
n = S2.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("C1 Empty Collection")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    img = S2.first()
    cloud = img.select('cloud').reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), loc, 30, maxPixels=1e9).get('cloud').getInfo()
    valid = img.select('B2').reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), loc, 60, maxPixels=1e9).get('B2').getInfo()
    if valid == 0:
        print("C2 No Valid Pixels")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    # 4. Calculation – test west drift
    summit = loc.buffer(1000)                     # near-vent
    west   = loc.buffer(5000).difference(loc.buffer(2000))  # west sector
    south  = loc.buffer(8000).difference(loc.buffer(6000))  # southern control
    B2mean = lambda g: img.select('B2').reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), g, 60, maxPixels=1e9).get('B2').getInfo()
    westV = B2mean(west)
    soutV = B2mean(south)
    print(f"Images: {n}  Cloud%: {cloud:.0f}  WestB2: {westV:.0f}  SouthB2: {soutV:.0f}  PixelsOK: {int(valid)}")
    if westV is None:  # None/NaN
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif westV > soutV + 2 and westV >= 1:  # plume brighter west than south -- simple heuristic
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
